name: Rajesh Mehta
message: Excellent quality hardware and very professional service. We have been sourcing our door fittings from Aditya Enterprises for 3 years now.

name: Priya Sharma
message: Great range of cabinet handles and glass fittings. Delivery was fast and the products matched exactly what was shown.

name: Amit Kulkarni
message: Reliable supplier for mortise locks and door closers. Pricing is competitive and support team is responsive.

name: Sneha Iyer
message: Bought door seals and hinges for our office renovation. Very happy with the quality and after-sales support.

name: Vikram Singh
message: Trusted hardware partner for all our projects. Their electric magnetic locks are top-notch quality.

name: Anjali Deshpande
message: Good products overall, packaging could be slightly better but the hardware itself is durable and well finished.
